content.text:
Repaired and resubmitted.

**What changed:** I verified the caption at p0520 — "ARTICLE X CONFIDENTIALITY" with Section 10.1 "Confidential Information" — so Article X/10 is indeed the confidentiality article. To remove any dependence on that cross-reference (and any tension with 16.5's reference to "INDEMNITIES PROVIDED PURSUANT TO ARTICLE 10"), the carve-out in new Section 16.7 is now drafted functionally: "either Party's **breach of its confidentiality obligations** under Article X (Confidentiality)".

**Result:** single insert of Section 16.7 — mutual aggregate cap, 12-month fee basis, and uncapped indemnification (16.1/16.2), confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct. All six fallback elements are now carried by operative language; 16.5 and the recall paragraph remain untouched.
